text: ついでに　おなかでも　さわって　みるか

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means to try doing it and see. さわって　みる = 'try touching'.

patterns.name: 〜でも (or something)
patterns.explanation: でも after a thing offers it as one loose suggestion, like 'or something'. おなかでも = 'my belly or something'.
